import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Suppress all warning messages
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"

# Create submission directory if not exists
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv"))

# Identify columns
id_col = "id"
target_col = "species"
feature_cols_train = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in [id_col, target_col]]
feature_cols_test = [c for c in test_df.columns if c != id_col]

# Extract features
X_train = train_df[feature_cols_train].values
y_train = train_df[target_col].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols_test].values
test_ids = test_df[id_col].values

# Validation Split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Model - ExtraTrees uses random feature selection at each split for better generalization
model = ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=150, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1, verbose=0)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Predictions
val_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)
test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Get correct species order from sample_submission
submission_species = sample_submission.columns[1:].tolist()

# Create mapping from model class index to submission species order
model_classes = model.classes_


# Function to calculate logloss exactly as defined
def calc_logloss(y_true, y_proba, species_order):
    N = y_proba.shape[0]
    n_species = len(species_order)
    eps = 1e-15

    log_loss_val = 0.0
    for i in range(N):
        # Create one-hot encoding for this sample
        y_i = np.zeros(n_species)
        label = y_true[i]
        if label in species_order:
            target_idx = species_order.index(label)
            y_i[target_idx] = 1

        # Clip probabilities to avoid log(0)
        p_i = np.clip(y_proba[i], eps, 1 - eps)

        # Calculate contribution: -sum(y * log(p))
        log_loss_val -= np.sum(y_i * np.log(p_i))

    return log_loss_val / N


# Reorder validation probabilities to match submission_species order
n_samples_val = len(y_val)
n_classes = len(model_classes)
n_species = len(submission_species)

val_proba_reordered = np.zeros((n_samples_val, n_species))
for i in range(n_samples_val):
    for model_class_idx in range(n_classes):
        class_name = model_classes[model_class_idx]
        prob_val = val_proba[i, model_class_idx]
        target_col_idx = submission_species.index(class_name)
        val_proba_reordered[i, target_col_idx] = prob_val

# Calculate Validation Metric
val_logloss = calc_logloss(y_val, val_proba_reordered, submission_species)
print(f"Validation LogLoss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Prepare Submission
# Reorder test probabilities to match submission_species
test_proba_reordered = np.zeros((len(test_ids), n_species))
for i in range(len(test_ids)):
    for model_class_idx in range(n_classes):
        class_name = model_classes[model_class_idx]
        prob_val = test_proba[i, model_class_idx]
        target_col_idx = submission_species.index(class_name)
        test_proba_reordered[i, target_col_idx] = prob_val

# Create submission dataframe
submission_output = pd.DataFrame(test_proba_reordered, columns=submission_species)
submission_output.insert(0, id_col, test_ids)
submission_output.to_csv(os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv"), index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
